sections.heading: Triage
paragraphs: The on-call analyst classifies incidents within 30 minutes, preserves event records and invokes containment runbooks. The September phishing exercise was closed in 22 minutes after mailbox isolation, token revocation and verification.

sections.heading: Notifications
paragraphs: For personal-data incidents, legal follows Breach Notification Matrix BNM-02 for regulator and customer decisions. The document register lists BNM-02 as awaiting owner approval and unavailable in the published repository.

sections.heading: Authority contact
paragraphs: The security manager maintains the sector authority contact list, including the national incident coordination desk; it was checked on 2026-09-12.
